mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and the consumer price index indicates an overheating economy with accelerating inflation, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (base 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (as indicated by GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), a decline in quarterly GDP growth signals an impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth declines in late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in monthly payroll growth below 0.5% signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
